name: Shadcn Spinner
summary: Lightweight customizable loading spinner component for shadcn-based projects, installable with the shadcn CLI.
description: A loading spinner component designed to integrate into projects based on shadcn, inspired by the Radix UI spinner design. It is lightweight and customizable, and can be added directly through the shadcn CLI. Demo at shadcn-spinner.vercel.app.
contains: loading spinner component for shadcn-based projects
inspired by the Radix UI spinner design
